## cluster

Run a cargoship cluster action from an Ansible inventory.

Include it as `colonel_byte.cargoship.cluster`.

Runs one cargoship action against the fleet described by the Ansible inventory, on the management node.

Every task carries `run_once: true` and delegates to `cargoship_delegate_to`. Cargoship converges the whole fleet in a single run, so a play over the fleet's own inventory would otherwise converge it once per host.

Ansible supplies the inventory and nothing else. It does not connect to the fleet, and nothing is installed on the managed nodes.

### Variables

| Variable                       | Type            | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------ | --------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cargoship_action`             | `str`           | `apply`     | The cargoship action to run. It selects which module the role calls. One of `apply`, `prepare`, `engine_config_sync`, `reset`, `kube_config`.                                                                                                                  |
| `cargoship_package`            | `str`           | `""`        | The distro package to install, stage, or synchronise from. Required by every action except `reset` and `kube_config`, which install nothing.                                                                                                                   |
| `cargoship_cluster`            | `dict`          | `{}`        | The settings that belong to the cluster rather than to any host. `name` and `loadbalancer` are required; `profiles`, `registries`, and `values` are optional and take the shape the inventory schema documents. See the inventory guide for the full document. |
| `cargoship_role_groups`        | `dict`          | `{}`        | The mapping from a cargoship role onto the Ansible groups that carry it, for an inventory that does not name its groups `controller` and `worker`. Left empty, the default mapping applies.                                                                    |
| `cargoship_inventory_path`     | `str`           | `""`        | Where to write the generated ZarfCluster document. A private temporary file when empty, removed after a run that succeeded.                                                                                                                                    |
| `cargoship_age_recipients`     | `list` of `str` | `[]`        | Age public keys used to encrypt registry credentials written to disk in the generated inventory document.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `cargoship_age_identity_files` | `list` of `str` | `[]`        | Paths to age identity files, or SSH private keys, used to decrypt registry credentials at apply time.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `cargoship_log_file`           | `bool`          | `false`     | Whether to always write a full-verbosity debug log to a file, regardless of log level.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `cargoship_args`               | `dict`          | `{}`        | Everything else the chosen module takes, passed through verbatim. See the generated module pages for the parameters of each module.                                                                                                                            |
| `cargoship_delegate_to`        | `str`           | `localhost` | The node cargoship runs on. It is the management node: the one the package and images were staged onto, which reaches the fleet over SSH. Set this to the inventory name of that node when it is not the Ansible controller.                                   |
| `cargoship_no_log`             | `bool`          | `true`      | Whether to suppress task parameter and result logging. Defaults to `true` to avoid exposing decrypted credentials and fleet inventories in logs. Set to `false` when debugging locally.                                                                        |
| `cargoship_show_result`        | `bool`          | `false`     | Whether to print cargoship's own report on the run. The task itself defaults to `no_log: true`, because a module's arguments name the fleet; the report holds file paths and phase names and no key material.                                                  |
